sentences.text: Sam and Maya are at the school.

They plan a trip and decide to travel by boat.

They think the gift will help the village.

Inside the box there is a note.
The note says the gift will be a present for the village.
If they answered a question they would get the gift.

The step is between the tree and the sea.
Sam see many step and think that is the correct answer.

They also find another map that shows a new cave near the sea.
The key is bright and it seem to light the area.
They hold it near the sun.

It leads them toward the deeper part of the island.

The gate goes to a new cave.
Inside the cave they hear a soft voice.
The voice asks them to answer a second question.
The voice says the answer is the name of the sea.
The sea touch the island.
Sam think about the map.
He remember that the sea is called the blue sea.
Maya says the answer is blue sea and the voice says happy.

A bright path appear on the ground.

Inside the chest they find a large bag of seed.
They also find a note that says the gift will help the village grow.
The note explain that the seed are from a rare plant.
The plant can give food for many years.
Sam and Maya take the bag of seed and the note.
They set the boat for home.
The boat comes at the village shore as the sun begins to set.
The villagers meet them.
The bag of seed is heavy but the box is strong.
They can carry it without trouble.
The villagers meet and listen.
Sam and Maya tell the story of the island and the gift.
They give the seed to the people.
The people put the seed in the ground.
